probes.title: install uv + source (uv sync) + tlog-rec per-distro (L0 hard prereq)
probes.command: echo '== install uv =='; curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh; . "$HOME/.local/bin/env" 2>/dev/null || . "$HOME/.cargo/env" 2>/dev/null || true; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"; uv --version || { echo PREP_UV_FAIL; exit 1; }; echo '== uploaded source tarball present? =='; TARBALL=$(ls "$HOME"/sandbox-ai-src*.tar.gz 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -n "$TARBALL" ] || { echo PREP_TARBALL_MISSING; exit 1; }; echo '== extract + uv sync =='; rm -rf "$HOME/sandbox-ai"; mkdir -p "$HOME/sandbox-ai"; tar -xzf "$TARBALL" -C "$HOME/sandbox-ai"; uv sync --directory "$HOME/sandbox-ai" 2>&1 | tail -6; "$HOME/sandbox-ai/.venv/bin/sandbox" --help >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo PREP_SANDBOX_INSTALLED_OK || { echo PREP_SANDBOX_INSTALL_FAIL; exit 1; }; echo '== install tlog-rec per-distro (best-effort; failure -> L0 refuses, which is a separate finding) =='; . /etc/os-release; if command -v tlog-rec >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'tlog-rec already present'; else ( case "${ID:-}" in ubuntu) sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -qq && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y tlog ;; debian) maj=$(echo "${VERSION_ID:-0}" | cut -d. -f1); if [ "${maj:-0}" -le 12 ] 2>/dev/null; then sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -qq && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y tlog; else echo "debian ${VERSION_ID}: source-building tlog"; sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -qq; sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y build-essential autoconf automake libtool m4 pkg-config git libjson-c-dev libsystemd-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev libutempter-dev; T=$(mktemp -d); git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/Scribery/tlog "$T/tlog"; cd "$T/tlog" && autoreconf -i -f && ./configure --prefix=/usr --sysconfdir=/etc --localstatedir=/var && make -j"$(nproc)" && sudo make install && sudo ldconfig; fi ;; fedora) sudo dnf -y install tlog ;; arch|manjaro) if command -v paru >/dev/null 2>&1; then paru -S --noconfirm tlog; elif command -v yay >/dev/null 2>&1; then yay -S --noconfirm tlog; else sudo pacman -Sy --needed --noconfirm base-devel git; T=$(mktemp -d); git clone --depth=1 https://aur.archlinux.org/yay.git "$T/yay"; cd "$T/yay" && makepkg -si --noconfirm && yay -S --noconfirm tlog; fi ;; esac ) || echo 'tlog install step returned non-zero'; fi; command -v tlog-rec >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo PREP_TLOG_OK || echo PREP_TLOG_MISSING_review
probes.classifies: PRE-REQ: the F-057-fixed `sandbox` CLI via `uv sync` from the uploaded source tarball, plus tlog-rec per-distro (the L0 hard prerequisite; also required by `sandbox attach`'s tlog-rec session recorder).

probes.title: operator-rootless setup (default): `sandbox setup --yes`, run as the operator
probes.command: export PATH="$HOME/sandbox-ai/.venv/bin:$PATH"; rc=0; OP=$(id -un); echo "operator: $OP (op-rootless refuses root; setup escalates the host-root batch internally)"; echo '== sandbox setup --yes (op-rootless default) =='; sandbox setup --yes 2>&1 | tee /tmp/setup.out; RC=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; echo "setup exit: $RC (0 expected)"; ( [ "$RC" -eq 0 ] && echo SETUP_EXIT0_OK || { echo SETUP_EXIT_NONZERO_FAIL; rc=1; } ); grep -qiE "Setup complete" /tmp/setup.out && echo SETUP_COMPLETE_OK || { echo SETUP_NO_COMPLETE_FAIL; rc=1; }; exit $rc
probes.classifies: Provision a converged op-rootless host. exit 0 + 'Setup complete'.

probes.title: init -> seed secrets -> `sandbox start` SUCCEEDS end-to-end (the F-057 fix: gVisor container now starts) + a container is running
probes.command: export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$(id -u); export DOCKER_HOST=unix://$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/docker.sock; export DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/bus; export PATH="$HOME/sandbox-ai/.venv/bin:$PATH"; rc=0; OP=$(id -un); echo "operator: $OP  vCPUs: $(nproc)  groups: $(id -nG)"; echo '== pre-seed per-operator host config (op-rootless: daemon owner IS the operator) =='; mkdir -p "$HOME/.sandbox-ai/config"; printf '[host]\ndocker_unprivileged_user = "%s"\n' "$OP" > "$HOME/.sandbox-ai/config/sandbox-ai.toml"; echo '== init (non-TTY stdin) =='; sandbox init smoke --empty main < /dev/null > /tmp/init.out 2>&1; IRC=$?; echo "init exit: $IRC"; ( [ "$IRC" -eq 0 ] && echo START_INIT_OK || { echo START_INIT_FAIL; rc=1; tail -20 /tmp/init.out; } ); echo '== seed dummy secrets so the start secret-completeness gate passes =='; ENVF="$HOME/.sandbox-ai/instances/smoke/.sandbox.env"; if [ -f "$ENVF" ]; then sed -i 's#^CORE_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=.*#CORE_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="sk-ant-dummy0000000000000000000000000000"#; s#^CORE_GITHUB_TOKEN=.*#CORE_GITHUB_TOKEN="ghp_dummy00000000000000000000000000000000"#' "$ENVF"; fi; echo '== start (no interactive handover) -- must reach exit 0 now F-057 is fixed =='; sandbox start smoke --no-handover > /tmp/start.out 2>&1; SRC=$?; echo "start exit: $SRC"; tail -30 /tmp/start.out; ( [ "$SRC" -eq 0 ] && echo START_EXIT0_OK || { echo START_EXIT_NONZERO_FAIL; rc=1; } ); echo '== regression guard: the F-057 systemd-cgroup error must be ABSENT =='; if grep -qiE "Interactive authentication required|systemd error|failed to create task" /tmp/start.out; then echo START_F057_ERROR_PRESENT_FAIL; rc=1; else echo START_NO_F057_ERROR_OK; fi; echo '== assert the CORE container (the attach target) is running, not just sidecars =='; docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}}' | grep -i smoke; if docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' 2>/dev/null | grep -q -- '-smoke-core-1'; then echo START_CORE_RUNNING_OK; else echo START_CORE_NOT_RUNNING_FAIL; rc=1; docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}}' | grep -i smoke; fi; exit $rc
probes.classifies: The F-057 fix end-to-end: init -> start reaches exit 0; the systemd-cgroup-scope error is absent; a container is running. Leaves the instance running for the ATTACH probe.

probes.title: `sandbox attach smoke main` non-interactive smoke: drive stdin through tlog-rec -> ssh -> /fwd -> core; land as `agent` in /workspaces/main
probes.command: export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$(id -u); export DOCKER_HOST=unix://$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/docker.sock; export DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/bus; export PATH="$HOME/sandbox-ai/.venv/bin:$PATH"; rc=0; echo '== confirm core running before attach =='; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -q -- '-smoke-core-1' && echo ATTACH_PRECOND_CORE_RUNNING_OK || { echo ATTACH_PRECOND_CORE_NOT_RUNNING_FAIL; rc=1; docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}}' | grep -i smoke; }; echo '== drive sandbox attach in a PTY via script(1); timed so bash -l is ready before commands are sent (interactive-shell-via-pipe races otherwise) =='; echo '== script(1) prerequisite (provided by vmlease host prep, not installed here) =='; command -v script >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo ATTACH_SCRIPT_TOOL_OK || { echo ATTACH_SCRIPT_TOOL_MISSING_FAIL; rc=1; }; rm -f /tmp/attach.ts; SBX="$HOME/sandbox-ai/.venv/bin/sandbox"; { sleep 6; printf 'echo RWHOAMI=$(whoami); echo RPWD=$(pwd)\n'; sleep 3; printf 'exit\n'; sleep 1; } | timeout 80 script -qec "$SBX attach smoke main" /tmp/attach.ts > /dev/null 2>&1; ARC=$?; echo "attach exit: $ARC"; echo '--- attach typescript (tail) ---'; tail -25 /tmp/attach.ts 2>/dev/null; echo '== PRIMARY: warm handover reached the agent shell in /workspaces/main (the prompt proves connection + cwd) =='; if grep -aq ':/workspaces/main' /tmp/attach.ts; then echo ATTACH_REACHED_WORKSPACE_OK; else echo ATTACH_NOT_REACHED_WORKSPACE_FAIL; rc=1; fi; echo '== SECONDARY (best-effort, interactive drive): piped commands executed as agent =='; grep -aq 'RWHOAMI=agent' /tmp/attach.ts && echo ATTACH_USER_AGENT_OK || echo ATTACH_USER_review; grep -aq 'RPWD=/workspaces/main' /tmp/attach.ts && echo ATTACH_CMD_PWD_OK || echo ATTACH_CMD_PWD_review; echo '== session log written? (tlog-rec --writer=file) =='; ls -la "$HOME/.sandbox-ai/sessions"/*/ 2>/dev/null | tail -3 && echo ATTACH_SESSION_LOG_PRESENT_review || echo ATTACH_NO_SESSION_LOG_review; exit $rc
probes.classifies: `sandbox attach` end-to-end (the never-before-smoked PTY-handover step). Drives stdin through the real tlog-rec -> ssh -> ProxyCommand(/fwd) -> core path; asserts the remote shell is `agent` in /workspaces/main and that attach exits cleanly (not a 124 hang). The session-log check is observational.

probes.title: `sandbox stop` brings the instance down, then `sandbox destroy --force` removes it cleanly
probes.command: export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$(id -u); export DOCKER_HOST=unix://$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/docker.sock; export DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/bus; export PATH="$HOME/sandbox-ai/.venv/bin:$PATH"; rc=0; echo '== stop =='; sandbox stop smoke > /tmp/stop.out 2>&1; STC=$?; echo "stop exit: $STC"; tail -15 /tmp/stop.out; ( [ "$STC" -eq 0 ] && echo STOP_EXIT0_OK || { echo STOP_EXIT_NONZERO_FAIL; rc=1; } ); echo '== assert no container running for the instance after stop =='; if docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' 2>/dev/null | grep -q smoke; then echo STOP_CONTAINER_STILL_RUNNING_FAIL; rc=1; else echo STOP_NO_CONTAINER_OK; fi; echo '== destroy (non-interactive: --force skips the typed-name confirm, --backup-workspaces=none skips backups) =='; sandbox destroy smoke --force --backup-workspaces=none > /tmp/destroy.out 2>&1; DRC=$?; echo "destroy exit: $DRC"; tail -15 /tmp/destroy.out; ( [ "$DRC" -eq 0 ] && echo DESTROY_EXIT0_OK || { echo DESTROY_EXIT_NONZERO_FAIL; rc=1; } ); echo '== assert instance dir + any container gone =='; if [ -d "$HOME/.sandbox-ai/instances/smoke" ]; then echo DESTROY_INSTANCE_DIR_REMAINS_review; ls -la "$HOME/.sandbox-ai/instances/smoke" | tail -5; else echo DESTROY_INSTANCE_DIR_GONE_OK; fi; if docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}' 2>/dev/null | grep -q smoke; then echo DESTROY_CONTAINER_REMAINS_FAIL; rc=1; else echo DESTROY_NO_CONTAINER_OK; fi; exit $rc
probes.classifies: Teardown end-to-end: stop -> exit 0 + no running container; destroy --force -> exit 0 + no leftover container. The instance-dir-removal check is observational (destroy's state-cleanup contract).
